reading.body:
South Dakota has two tracked data centers, both clustered in the Sioux Falls area, and together they report zero megawatts of recorded power draw.

The two facilities, ADP South Dakota and TierPoint Sioux Falls West, sit within a few miles of each other in the Minnehaha County and Sioux Falls area. Their geographic proximity suggests regional infrastructure logic, likely shared access to fiber corridors or favorable power rates, but the data does not confirm either.

The zero total megawatt figure is the most significant gap here. It means either power capacity was not collected for these facilities or was not disclosed, not that the sites consume no power. No conclusions about South Dakota's contribution to AI compute supply can be drawn from that number alone.

The dataset covers only two facilities. It does not indicate whether additional data centers in South Dakota exist but are untracked, nor does it speak to planned capacity, ownership beyond the named operators, or any connection to AI-specific workloads.

facilities.name: TierPoint Sioux Falls West Data Center
